title: Vision2Code: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating Image-to-Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.11307v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study whether vision-language models (VLMs) can reconstruct structured, graphics-based images by writing executable code to generate them. Existing benchmarks on image-to-code generation are generally limited in the domains they cover, rely on reference source code for evaluation, and do not provide metrics to quantify domain-specific issues. To address this, we introduce Vision2Code, a multi-domain, reference-code-free benchmark containing 539 test examples from 15 different datasets, spanning charts and plots, geometry, graphs, scientific diagrams, documents and 3D spatial scenes. Evaluation is done by executing the generated programs and comparing their rendered outputs to the source images using dataset- and domain-specific rubrics for a VLM judge. We find that the final scores obtained in this manner have substantially higher correlation with human ratings than those obtained via generic VLM rubrics or standard pixel-ba

translated_title: Vision2Code：用于评估图像到代码生成的多领域基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们研究视觉语言模型（VLM）能否通过编写可执行代码来重构结构化的、基于图形的图像。现有的图像到代码生成基准通常在覆盖领域上存在局限，依赖参考源代码进行评估，且缺乏量化领域特定问题的指标。为解决这些问题，我们推出了Vision2Code——一个多领域、无需参考代码的基准，包含来自15个不同数据集的539个测试样例，涵盖图表与绘图、几何、图结构、科学示意图、文档以及3D空间场景。评估方式是执行生成的程序，并使用针对数据集和领域定制的评分标准由VLM充当评判者，将其渲染输出与源图像进行比较。我们发现，通过这种方式获得的最终评分与人类评分的相关性显著高于使用通用VLM评分标准或标准像素级指标所获得的评分。
tldr: 提出了Vision2Code——一个覆盖15个数据集共539个样例、无需参考源代码的多领域图像到代码生成基准，通过执行生成代码并结合领域定制评分标准进行评估，其评分与人类评分的相关性显著优于通用评估指标。
en_tdlr: Vision2Code is a multi-domain, reference-code-free benchmark of 539 examples across 15 datasets for evaluating image-to-code generation, whose execution-based, domain-specific scoring correlates substantially better with human ratings than generic VLM or pixel-based metrics.
